CustomField.label: Assessment Score
CustomField.description: Sum of scored answers from the migration-readiness questionnaire, 8-32 (Q0 routing question excluded). Every dimension is scored so that 4 = lowest migration risk, so a high total means a small, portable, well-owned estate. Computed at submission time by GtmAssessmentScoring, server-side, from the raw answers only. The separate Estate_Complexity_Score__c axis is deliberately NOT added into this number.
